title: Analyst Insights: Silicon metal
gist: Thin video-listing page: Benchmark research manager Evan Hartley introduces silicon metal, one of 10 new markets Benchmark is now covering, alongside parallel intros for tungsten, uranium and germanium. No substantive analysis is given in the text.

insights.claim: Benchmark has added silicon metal as one of 10 new markets it covers, with research manager Evan Hartley presenting it, and silicon metal is tagged alongside aluminium.
insights.speaker: Evan Hartley, Research Manager, Benchmark; Bryan Bille, Lead Policy and Geopolitical Analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Signals Benchmark will publish price and supply-chain data for silicon metal, a market with little public benchmarking.

insights.claim: Benchmark is rolling out coverage of 10 new critical mineral markets, with introductory videos published for tungsten, uranium, germanium and silicon metal in the same week.
insights.speaker: Evan Hartley, Research Manager, Benchmark; Bryan Bille, Lead Policy and Geopolitical Analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Watch for Benchmark price assessments in these minor and critical metals as new reference points for contracts and trading.
insights.quote: one of 10 new markets being covered by Benchmark

insights.claim: Benchmark's 6 October 2026 Africa-focused panels covered critical mineral regulation, energy transition geopolitics including the Lobito Corridor, and financing for battery, EV and critical minerals projects.
insights.speaker: Evan Hartley, Research Manager, Benchmark; Bryan Bille, Lead Policy and Geopolitical Analyst, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Indicates policy, trade corridors and project finance are the framing themes for African battery-materials supply chains.

source_meta.author: Evan Hartley, Research Manager, Benchmark; Bryan Bille, Lead Policy and Geopolitical Analyst, Benchmark
